available_components: stage 1 hidden-state alignment and stage 2/3 training source
layerwise replacement, evaluation, and importance-ranking source
206 per-layer commonsense and retrieval evaluation logs across three scales
custom Lightning Attention, GDN, KDA, cache, and Hugging Face model source
declared exact development stack and eight-A800 hardware in README files
identity_and_behavior_findings: the 2B config contains seven full-attention and twenty-one Lightning Attention layers, resolving the paper HTML table ambiguity
the paper defines epsilon as 1e-6 but layer_analysis.py uses 1e-10 and clips the importance score at 50
the repository has no root license, so source inspection does not grant reuse rights
requirements.txt is unpinned despite exact versions being listed narratively in the README
training configs contain machine-local or placeholder paths and the streamed FineWeb-Edu revision/order is not pinned
the selection README references one stale script name and requires a Stage-1 checkpoint not shipped in the Git tree
no assertion-based test suite is present
model checkpoints are linked externally and their immutable revisions, weights, custom-code identity, and parity remain unaudited

decision.next_action: treat HALO as a mandatory conceptual and logged-result baseline; do not execute or reuse upstream code before rights and semantic reconciliation
